verdict: GitLab: Choose GitLab when a DevSecOps platform (git + CI + security) is the job — not GitHub Copilot and not Bitbucket-as-cheap-git. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.

recommendation: Choose GitLab when a DevSecOps platform (git + CI + security) is the job — not GitHub Copilot and not Bitbucket-as-cheap-git. Compare GitHub for ecosystem + Actions; Bitbucket if you are Atlassian-native and need cheaper git+Pipelines.

Source-control + CI/CD DevOps platform — peer of GitHub/Bitbucket, not Datadog.
Repo + CI + security in one product is the depth lead vs Bitbucket; GitHub remains the network-effect peer.
Jira/Slack native; GitHub-equivalent marketplace is thinner.

$29 Premium vs GitHub Team $4 is a different product (CI/DevSecOps). Fair for the scope; not a cheap git host. Affiliate economics excluded.
GitLab Duo / AI features on paid platforms — scored as platform AI, not GitHub Copilot.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
